name: vintage-travel-ticket
title_zh: 66 张老车票里抽一套设计语法，每次出票都像翻到旧藏
tagline_zh: 从 66 张历史票据里蒸馏出的设计语法：结构原型、插画语言、配色、纸张、字体、信息格式、印刷老化，每次随机选一套自洽的组合。
tagline_en: A design grammar distilled from 66 historical tickets — archetype, illustration, palette, paper, type, information layout, print ageing — one coherent set picked at random each time.
desc_en: A design grammar distilled from 66 historical tickets — archetype, illustration, palette, paper, type, information layout, print ageing — one coherent set picked at random each time.
why_zh: 它生成前先核对景点或食物的官方名称，票面上的字是查过的，不是编的。
why_en: It verifies the official place or food name before generating; the words on the ticket are checked, not invented.
limit_zh: 只出一张成品票，不出可编辑源文件。那 66 张参考图作者没有随仓分发，你拿到的只是从中提炼的规则。组合是随机选的，想指定某种风格得自己改提示。
limit_en: One finished ticket, no editable source. The 66 reference images are not distributed.
title_en: A random vintage ticket grammar from 66 real ones, every.
